chunks: Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim said: We said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

these winds and darknesses that occur, is prayer offered for them? He said: 'Every phenomenon in the sky of darkness, or wind, or alarm, offer prayer for it the prayer of the eclipse until it subsides.'

key_terms.أَخَاوِيفِ: Phenomena/Events (plural of khawf, referring to things that cause fear or awe in the sky)
key_terms.الظُّلَمُ: Darknesses (referring to atmospheric darkness or gloom)
key_terms.الْفَزَعٍ: Alarm/Fright (sudden atmospheric disturbance or noise causing fear)
key_terms.الْكُسُوفِ: Eclipse (specifically solar or lunar, triggering a specific ritual prayer)

ai.seo_question: What natural phenomena trigger the obligation of the Eclipse Prayer (Salat al-Kusuf) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) expands the scope of Salat al-Kusuf beyond mere eclipses to include any significant atmospheric disturbances like darkness, wind, or sudden alarm (faz'). This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that these phenomena serve as divine signs (ayat) calling for communal prayer and reflection until the disturbance ceases.
